name: coordination/task-status-reply
description: `task_status` for a task this surface dispatched (ADR-0016 §2). Addressable by the dispatch receipt or by the staged reference — and by nothing else. `egress` is where the bytes got to; `verification.state` is `acknowledged` exactly when the pinned recipient echoed this staged digest and `unacknowledged` otherwise. `result_manifest_digest` and `outcome_state` are PERMANENTLY null rather than pending: a coordination dispatch is not a contract, so no result manifest and no requester outcome will ever exist for it, and reporting them as awaited would be the kind of lie a fail-closed capability matrix cannot detect.

verification.detail: the pinned recipient acknowledged this staged digest; a coordination dispatch carries no contract, so no result manifest or outcome is verifiable against it
